description: Improve UI/UX with better user feedback, animations, accessibility, toast notifications, and responsive design polish
steps: UX 1 - Add a toast notification system: Replace all alert() and confirm() calls with a proper toast/notification component. Create src/components/Toast.tsx with a context provider. Support success, error, warning, info types. Auto-dismiss after configurable timeout. Add slide-in animation.

UX 2 - Add auto-save indicator in Editor toolbar: Show a subtle status indicator (saving..., saved, error) near the scene name so users know their work is being persisted. Use the useAutoSave hook's state.
UX 3 - Add loading skeleton states: Replace the simple spinner in Dashboard with skeleton cards that match the scene-card shape. Add a pulsing animation. This gives better perceived performance.
UX 4 - Improve the empty state on Dashboard: Add a more visually appealing empty state with an illustration (SVG) and clearer call-to-action button instead of just an emoji and text.

UX 5 - Add keyboard shortcut hints to toolbar tooltips: Show the shortcut key in the tooltip (e.g. 'Rectangle (R)') using native title attributes that are already there, but make them use data-tooltip CSS for better styled tooltips.
UX 6 - Add a confirmation dialog component: Replace browser confirm() with a styled modal confirmation dialog (src/components/ConfirmDialog.tsx) that matches the app's design language.

UX 7 - Improve form validation UX: Show inline validation errors below form fields with smooth height animation instead of a single error banner at the top. Add password strength indicator on signup page.
UX 8 - Add smooth page transitions: Add a simple fade transition when navigating between pages using CSS transitions on route changes.

UX 9 - Improve mobile responsiveness: The tools-group on mobile wraps awkwardly. Add a collapsible 'more tools' button on mobile that reveals less-used tools in a popover. Ensure touch targets are at least 44px.
acceptance_criteria: No browser alert() or confirm() calls remain in the codebase
Auto-save status is visible in the editor toolbar
Dashboard shows skeleton loading state instead of a bare spinner
All interactive elements have proper ARIA attributes
Toast notifications appear with animations for user actions
Mobile layout is usable with proper touch targets
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit and confirm no type errors
Run npx vitest run and confirm all tests pass
Grep for 'alert(' and 'confirm(' to confirm they are removed from user-facing code
